papas-donuteria.summary: Papa's Donuteria puts you in charge of preparing doughnuts for customers. Read each order, prepare the doughnuts, and match the requested toppings.
papas-donuteria.how_to: Check the customer's order before preparing ingredients. Use the mouse to select items and drag ingredients while you work through the order.
tips: Finish the current preparation step before moving to the next station.
Compare the topping choices with the order before serving.

tiny-clash.summary: Tiny Clash is an army-building strategy game. Buy units, merge matching troops into stronger units, then send the army into an automatic battle.
tiny-clash.how_to: Buy units, drag identical troops together on the grid to merge them, then select FIGHT to start the battle.
tips: Check that two units have the same type and level before trying to merge them.
Use earned coins to strengthen the army before retrying a battle.

classic-sudoku.summary: Classic Sudoku is a number-placement puzzle. Fill the grid so each row, column, and 3-by-3 box contains the digits 1 through 9 without repetition.
classic-sudoku.how_to: Select an empty cell and choose a number that does not already appear in its row, column, or 3-by-3 box.
tips: Look for rows, columns, or boxes with only one missing number.
Check the crossing row and column before committing to a number.

chrome-dino.summary: Dinosaur Game is an endless runner starring a pixel dinosaur. Jump over obstacles and duck when needed to keep the run going.
chrome-dino.how_to: Press Space or the Up arrow to jump. Use the Down arrow to duck while watching for the next obstacle.
tips: Time jumps around the next obstacle rather than pressing repeatedly.
Watch the space ahead as the run speeds up.

dinosaur-game.summary: Dinosaur Game is a browser runner built around avoiding obstacles. Keep the dinosaur moving by timing jumps as hazards approach.
dinosaur-game.how_to: Check the start screen for the jump control, then time jumps to clear the obstacles in front of the dinosaur.
tips: Leave enough space to land before the next jump.
Use short attempts to learn the distance needed to clear each obstacle.

geometr-jump.summary: Geometry Jump is a precision platform game about moving between pillars. Choose short or long jumps while avoiding the saw blade.
geometr-jump.how_to: Use the short and long jump options shown by the game to move between pillars without touching the saw blade.
tips: Choose the jump distance to fit the gap ahead.
Wait until the route past the saw blade is clear before jumping.

block-puzzle-master.summary: Block Blaster is a grid puzzle about fitting fixed block shapes into an 8-by-8 board. Complete horizontal or vertical lines to clear space for the next pieces.
block-puzzle-master.how_to: Drag a block onto the board and fill rows or columns to remove them. The pieces cannot be rotated, so compare their shapes with the open spaces before placing them.
tips: Keep an area open for larger pieces instead of filling every small gap.
Look for a placement that helps complete both a row and a column.

build-and-crush.page_title: Build and Crush - Building and Destruction Guide
build-and-crush.summary: Build and Crush combines a block-building sandbox with a destruction mode. Create structures, then choose weapons and tools to demolish creations.
build-and-crush.how_to: In Build mode, move with WASD, place blocks with the right mouse button, and remove them with the left. In Crush mode, select a weapon from the screen and follow its control prompts.
tips: Use free flight to inspect a creation before choosing where to attack.
Check the control prompts again when switching weapons; their inputs differ.

getaway-shootout.page_title: Getaway Shootout - Two-Player Controls and Guide
getaway-shootout.summary: Getaway Shootout is a jumping race with local two-player controls. Reach the getaway while collecting power-ups and coping with movement limited to left and right jumps.
getaway-shootout.how_to: Player one uses W and E to jump left and right, and R for a power-up. Player two uses I and O to jump, and P for a power-up.
tips: Practise alternating left and right jumps before racing for a power-up.
Check your landing position before committing to the next jump.

mr-dude-online-multiverse-challenge.page_title: Mr. Dude - Multiplayer Challenges and Controls
mr-dude-online-multiverse-challenge.summary: Mr. Dude: Online Multiverse Challenge is a multiplayer challenge game with movement, jumping, boosters, and different activities. The selected mode determines which objectives and interactions matter.
mr-dude-online-multiverse-challenge.how_to: On desktop, move with WASD and jump with Space. Keys 1 through 4 activate boosters; E interacts with items in panic room mode. Mobile builds provide on-screen buttons.
tips: Read the selected mode's objective before using a booster.
Try the movement and interaction controls before joining the busiest part of a challenge.

far-orion-new-worlds.page_title: Far Orion: New Worlds - Heroes and Battle Guide
far-orion-new-worlds.summary: Far Orion: New Worlds is a squad strategy game built around heroes and battle cards. Assemble a team, choose skill targets, and use resources to strengthen it between missions.
far-orion-new-worlds.how_to: Use the mouse to select heroes, targets, and battle cards. Skills consume energy that refills over time, so choose when to spend it rather than activating everything at once.
tips: Compare support and attack skills when building the squad.
Save enough energy for the next important skill instead of spending it as soon as it appears.

battleship.page_title: Battleship - Naval Strategy and How to Play
battleship.summary: Battleship is a naval strategy game about locating an opponent's hidden fleet. Arrange your ships and use the results of each shot to narrow down the remaining positions.
battleship.how_to: Use the mouse to place the fleet and select squares to attack. After a hit, investigate the nearby squares to work out the ship's direction.
tips: Use misses to rule out areas instead of firing repeatedly in the same place.
After finding a ship, follow its line before returning to the wider search.

ducklife.page_title: Duck Life - Training, Racing and Controls
ducklife.summary: Duck Life combines duck training with races. Improve running, flying, and swimming through minigames, feed the duck for energy, and enter races to earn money for the damaged farm.
ducklife.how_to: Choose a training activity and follow its arrow-key controls. Build the duck's skills, replenish its energy with food, then enter a race when it is ready.
tips: Train all three movement skills rather than relying on one strong activity.
Check energy before a race; training and feeding have different roles.

cuphead.page_title: Cuphead - Browser Airplane Battle and Controls
cuphead.summary: This Cuphead browser listing features a side-scrolling airplane boss encounter. Move around incoming attacks while shooting, shrinking, parrying, and using a superpower.
cuphead.how_to: In one-player mode, use the arrow keys to move, X to shoot, C to shrink, Z to parry, and V for the superpower. Two-player mode uses different action keys, listed below.
tips: Learn the one-player key layout before switching to the two-player setup.
Keep room to dodge instead of staying against the edge of the play area.

house-of-hazards.page_title: House of Hazards - Local Multiplayer Guide
house-of-hazards.summary: House of Hazards is a local multiplayer game about completing household tasks while other players trigger hazards. Take turns navigating the house and interrupting the other players.
house-of-hazards.how_to: Player one uses A and D to move, W to jump, and S for crouching, grabbing, or activating a hazard. Player two uses J, L, I, and K for the equivalent actions.
tips: Watch the timing of a hazard before moving through its path.
Agree on the keyboard layout before starting a shared-screen round.

faq.question: Can more than two people play House of Hazards?
faq.answer: The source provides keyboard controls for players one and two, and gamepad controls for players three and four. Extra players need gamepads.

dead-land-survival.page_title: Dead Land: Survival - Shelter and Resource Guide
dead-land-survival.summary: Dead Land: Survival is a survival game set in a zombie-filled world. Scavenge for resources, develop your skills, and improve a shelter while dealing with hostile encounters.
dead-land-survival.how_to: Use the mouse to choose activities and manage the game interface. Gather supplies and review shelter and character upgrades as the available resources change.
tips: Check the resources needed for an upgrade before spending supplies elsewhere.
Review shelter needs between scavenging activities.

pirates-of-the-caribbean-tow.page_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: ToW - Fleet Guide
pirates-of-the-caribbean-tow.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean: Tides of War is a fleet and fortress strategy game. Build a pirate hideout, improve ships, and take part in quests and alliance activities.
pirates-of-the-caribbean-tow.how_to: Click objects and interface buttons to manage the fortress and fleet. Use the mouse wheel to change the map zoom while choosing where to explore or attack.
tips: Check ship and fortress upgrades together when deciding how to spend resources.
Use the map zoom to inspect a destination before sending a fleet.

warlord-fantasy-rpg.page_title: Warlord: Fantasy RPG - Equipment and Battle Guide
warlord-fantasy-rpg.summary: Warlord: Fantasy RPG is an online fantasy adventure centred on character equipment and battles. Collect weapons and armour, explore dungeons, and take part in player and clan activities.
warlord-fantasy-rpg.how_to: Use the mouse to navigate the game menus and choose activities. Review equipment and available improvements before entering the next battle or dungeon.
tips: Compare new equipment with the items already equipped.
Check the requirements of an activity before committing resources to it.

magic-world.page_title: Magic World - Gem Matching Battle Guide
magic-world.summary: Magic World combines gem-matching puzzles with fantasy battles. Plan matches on the board while facing different creatures and opponents.
magic-world.how_to: Use the mouse to interact with the gem board and battle interface. Compare the available matches before choosing the next move.
tips: Look across the whole board before taking the first available match.
Read the current battle information when deciding which match to make.

heroes-assemble.page_title: Heroes Assemble - Hero and Pet Team Guide
heroes-assemble.summary: Heroes Assemble is a team-building adventure with heroes, pets, dungeons, and battles. Combine characters and companions, manage resources, and improve the team through different activities.
heroes-assemble.how_to: Use the mouse to collect and organise heroes and pets, select activities, and manage upgrades. Check the team before moving into a new dungeon or battle.
tips: Consider how a pet supports the chosen heroes rather than selecting each separately.
Compare upgrade needs with the resources available before spending them.

castle-craft.page_title: Castle Craft - Resource Merging and Exploration
castle-craft.summary: Castle Craft is a merging puzzle adventure about exploring a fog-covered land. Combine resources and use discovered items and keys while following Fiona's search for Michael.
castle-craft.how_to: Drag items with the left mouse button to merge them. Follow the current task and use the resources you create to continue exploring.
tips: Check the task requirements before merging away an item you may need.
Keep enough board space to organise the next group of resources.

daily-room-escape.page_title: Daily Room Escape - Clue and Puzzle Guide
daily-room-escape.summary: Daily Room Escape is an escape-room puzzle built around hidden clues and linked riddles. Inspect the room, connect the information you find, and work toward the way out.
daily-room-escape.how_to: Click objects and puzzle elements to inspect them. Keep track of clues and revisit a puzzle after finding information elsewhere in the room.
tips: Compare symbols and patterns before trying combinations at random.
Recheck previously inspected objects when a new clue changes their meaning.

battle-arena.page_title: Battle Arena - Hero Team and Battle Guide
battle-arena.summary: Battle Arena is an RPG strategy game about assembling a team of heroes. Choose characters, develop the squad, and take it into battles through the game interface.
battle-arena.how_to: Use the mouse to select heroes, manage the team, and interact with battle and progression menus. Review the squad before starting the next encounter.
tips: Compare the roles of the selected heroes when adjusting the team.
Review available improvements after a difficult encounter.

hex-empire.summary: Hex Empire is a turn-based strategy game about expanding a nation across a map. Move armies, attack cities, and plan how to hold the territory you capture.
hex-empire.how_to: Use the mouse to select armies and choose moves on the map. Consider the position of neighbouring armies before committing to an attack.
tips: Plan how to defend a captured city before pushing farther into the map.
Look at the surrounding territory as well as the immediate target.

dark-stones-card-battle-rpg.page_title: Dark Stones - Card Battle and Team Guide
dark-stones-card-battle-rpg.summary: Dark Stones: Card Battle RPG is a fantasy card-battle game about building a team of creatures and characters. Defeat opponents, collect new powers, and adjust the team for later encounters.
dark-stones-card-battle-rpg.how_to: Use the mouse to manage the card team and interact with battle menus. Read the available card and character information before choosing the next action.
tips: Compare the abilities of a new card with the needs of the current team.
Check the opponent and battle information before changing the line-up.

mirrorland.summary: Mirrorland is a turn-based fantasy adventure with heroes, quests, and battles. Create a character, explore the world, and form alliances while following the story.
mirrorland.how_to: Follow the provider's account and character setup, then use the mouse to interact with the world and game interface. Read the current quest before choosing the next activity.
tips: Review the current quest when deciding where to explore next.
Inspect rewards and character improvements between encounters.

faq.question: Does Mirrorland require an account?
faq.answer: The source listing says an online account and character setup are required to start Mirrorland. BTW game's catalog itself can be browsed without an account.

ragdoll-archers.page_title: Ragdoll Archers - Bow Controls and Game Modes
ragdoll-archers.summary: Ragdoll Archers is an archery game with physics-driven stick figures. Aim at opponents, earn points, and improve the archer's abilities and ammunition.
ragdoll-archers.how_to: In single-player mode, control the archer with the left mouse button and jump with Space. Shared-keyboard modes use WASD and left Shift for player one, and arrow keys and right Shift for player two.
tips: Adjust the next shot using the result of the previous arrow.
Check the control layout for the selected mode before starting a two-player game.

stone-grass-mowing-simulator.page_title: Stone Grass - Mowing Simulator and Controls
stone-grass-mowing-simulator.summary: Stone Grass: Mowing Simulator is a grass-clearing game controlled by moving a mower through overgrown fields. Clear the landscape by guiding the vehicle across the remaining patches.
stone-grass-mowing-simulator.how_to: Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging the left mouse button. Steer through the grass and adjust the route to cover areas left behind.
tips: Use overlapping passes to avoid leaving narrow strips of grass.
Check the edges of a cleared area before moving on.

arkadium-s-bubble-shooter.page_title: Arkadium's Bubble Shooter - Matching and Controls
arkadium-s-bubble-shooter.summary: Arkadium's Bubble Shooter is a colour-matching puzzle. Shoot bubbles into groups of three or more matching colours to remove them and build a score.
arkadium-s-bubble-shooter.how_to: Aim with the mouse and left-click to shoot. Right-click to switch the loaded bubble when the other colour gives you a better match.
tips: Compare the loaded and spare bubble before taking a difficult shot.
Look for a match that opens access to bubbles behind it.

bubble-blast-pwd.page_title: Bubble Blast - Bubble Aiming and Quest Guide
bubble-blast-pwd.summary: Bubble Blast is a bubble-shooting puzzle with quests to complete. Aim matching colours into the board and check the current objective as the bubbles are cleared.
bubble-blast-pwd.how_to: Drag with the left mouse button to aim and shoot bubbles. Read the quest objective before deciding which part of the board to target.
tips: Prioritise bubbles that help the current quest.
Check the route to a target before releasing the shot.

lumber-harvest-tree-cutting-game.page_title: Lumber Harvest - Tractor and Upgrade Guide
lumber-harvest-tree-cutting-game.summary: Lumber Harvest: Tree Cutting Game is a logging progression game. Drive a tractor through trees, collect timber, and use upgrades to expand the harvesting operation.
lumber-harvest-tree-cutting-game.how_to: Steer with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging the mouse. Harvest trees and compare saw and capacity improvements as resources become available.
tips: Consider carrying capacity as well as cutting power when choosing an upgrade.
Plan a route through the trees before repeatedly changing direction.

count-masters-stickman-games.page_title: Count Masters - Crowd Running and Controls
count-masters-stickman-games.summary: Count Masters: Stickman Games is a runner about growing a crowd of stickmen. Choose routes that increase the group while steering around obstacles and rival crowds.
count-masters-stickman-games.how_to: Move left and right with the mouse or arrow keys. Compare the upcoming paths, then steer toward the option that helps the crowd survive and grow.
tips: Look ahead before changing lanes so a useful path does not lead straight into an obstacle.
Preserve the crowd when a risky route offers only a small advantage.

bubble-fall.page_title: Bubble Fall - Colour Matching and Controls
bubble-fall.summary: Bubble Fall is a bubble shooter in which matched balls fall away from the board. Aim at groups of the loaded colour and use the result to open new shots.
bubble-fall.how_to: Move the mouse to aim and left-click to shoot. Check which colour is loaded before choosing a target group.
tips: Look for a match that clears a useful route through the board.
Reassess the layout after the falling bubbles change the available targets.

bubble-tower-3d.page_title: Bubble Tower 3D - Rotating Tower Puzzle Guide
bubble-tower-3d.summary: Bubble Tower 3D wraps a bubble-shooting puzzle around a cylinder. Rotate the tower to inspect its sides, then shoot at matching colours.
bubble-tower-3d.how_to: Drag with the left mouse button to turn the cylinder and left-click to shoot. Rotate again when the visible side does not offer a useful match.
tips: Inspect more than one side before spending a difficult colour.
Recheck the tower after clearing a group because new targets may become visible.

geometry-dash-online.page_title: Geometry Game - Rhythm Platformer and Controls
geometry-dash-online.summary: Geometry Game is a side-scrolling platformer built around timed jumps and musical rhythm. Avoid spikes and adapt to sections that change how the character or vehicle moves.
geometry-dash-online.how_to: Press Space or the Up arrow to jump, and hold to repeat jumps where appropriate. Vehicle sections use the arrow keys to steer up or down.
tips: Learn the position of the next obstacle rather than relying on rhythm alone.
Check for a change in movement controls when a new section begins.

getting-over-it.page_title: Getting Over It - Browser Climbing Guide
getting-over-it.summary: Getting Over It is a physics climbing challenge controlled with a hammer. Use mouse movements to push, hook, and swing upward through obstacles; this listing credits the browser build to Griffpatch.
getting-over-it.how_to: Move the mouse to position the hammer against the terrain. Use controlled pushes and swings to lift the character toward the next stable position.
tips: Practise small hammer movements before attempting a long swing.
Look for a stable resting point before making the next climb.

squirrel-with-a-gun.page_title: Squirrel with a Gun! - Mouse and Recoil Guide
squirrel-with-a-gun.summary: Squirrel with a Gun! is an arcade shooter with ragdoll movement and strong weapon recoil. Use shooting and movement together to deal with enemies and obstacles.
squirrel-with-a-gun.how_to: Use the mouse to play; the source describes left-clicking to move and shoot together. Account for the movement caused by recoil when lining up another shot.
tips: Watch where recoil will move the character before firing.
Change shot timing when an obstacle or enemy makes the previous approach unsafe.

jet-rush.page_title: Jet Rush - Obstacle Flying and Controls
jet-rush.summary: Jet Rush is an arcade flying game about guiding a jet through obstacle-filled courses. Read the route ahead and make timely left and right steering corrections.
jet-rush.how_to: Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to steer. Space confirms a menu selection.
tips: Look toward the next opening instead of focusing only on the jet.
Use small steering corrections when a narrow gap is approaching.

color-tunnel.page_title: Color Tunnel - Obstacle Runner and Controls
color-tunnel.summary: Color Tunnel is an endless runner through a fast-moving tunnel. Shift left and right to pass openings and avoid the obstacles ahead.
color-tunnel.how_to: Use the left and right arrow keys to move around the tunnel. Watch the upcoming pattern before changing direction.
tips: Aim for an opening early instead of making a large correction at the last moment.
Read the next obstacle as soon as the current one is passed.

stacky-bird.page_title: Stacky Bird - Egg Stacking and Controls
stacky-bird.summary: Stacky Bird is an arcade runner in which egg stacks lift a bird over obstacles. Time the stack height to clear the route without crashing.
stacky-bird.how_to: Tap or hold Space, or click and hold the left mouse button, to lay eggs. Build the stack in response to the height of the next obstacle.
tips: Watch the next obstacle while building the current stack.
Practise short holds to learn how quickly the stack grows.

piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.page_title: Piece of Cake - Merge and Cafe Guide
piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.summary: Piece of Cake: Merge and Bake is a merging puzzle with a cafe story. Help Emily restore the family business by combining items and completing tasks that move the story forward.
piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.how_to: Use the mouse to select interface buttons and drag an item onto a matching object to merge it. Check the current task before making the next combination.
tips: Keep space on the board for items needed by the current task.
Compare task requirements before merging a useful object into something else.

hidden-objects.page_title: Hidden Objects - Search and Zoom Controls
hidden-objects.summary: Hidden Objects is a visual search puzzle set in detailed interiors. Inspect each scene and locate the objects required by the current search.
hidden-objects.how_to: Left-click an object when you find it. Use the mouse wheel, the plus and minus controls, or a touchpad pinch to change the zoom.
tips: Search one part of the scene at a time instead of repeatedly scanning the whole image.
Use zoom to inspect a small object, then zoom out to regain the wider context.

color-tap-coloring-by-numbers.page_title: Color Tap - Colour by Numbers and Controls
color-tap-coloring-by-numbers.summary: Color Tap: Coloring by Numbers is a picture-colouring game organised by numbered regions. Select a colour and fill the corresponding parts of the image.
color-tap-coloring-by-numbers.how_to: Use the left mouse button to choose and apply colours. Use the mouse wheel to zoom when a small region is difficult to see.
tips: Zoom in to finish small regions before changing the view.
Work through one colour at a time when the picture contains many similar areas.

screw-out-bolts-and-nuts.page_title: Screw Out - Bolt Sorting and Puzzle Guide
screw-out-bolts-and-nuts.summary: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is a logic puzzle about removing bolts from shapes and sorting them into colour-matched containers. Plan the removal order as the available positions change.
screw-out-bolts-and-nuts.how_to: Left-click a bolt to unscrew it. Compare its colour with the containers and check what the removal will uncover before choosing another bolt.
tips: Look at the next accessible bolts before removing the current one.
Use the available container space deliberately instead of choosing colours at random.

farm-merge-valley.page_title: Farm Merge Valley - Farming and Merging Guide
farm-merge-valley.summary: Farm Merge Valley combines farm development with item merging. Combine animals and objects, grow crops, and expand the farm into new areas.
farm-merge-valley.how_to: Hold the left mouse button to pick up and move objects on the grid. Group matching items and follow the current farm tasks while managing the available space.
tips: Check farm objectives before combining objects needed for a task.
Keep some room available for new crops, animals, and merge results.

designville-merge-design.summary: Designville: Merge & Design combines a merging board with home renovation. Help Louise and Robin create items, complete tasks, and turn an abandoned house into a design studio.
designville-merge-design.how_to: Use the mouse to open item containers and merge matching objects on the board. Complete the renovation tasks with the items and resources you create.
tips: Check the renovation task list before filling the board with new objects.
Leave enough space to combine items and collect the next useful result.
